entry: Does fixture_entry refuse NULL pointers and n outside [1, 64] before it reads x or writes out?
Does fixture_run bound the argument comparison and handle a NULL argv or argument?

findings.property: out-of-bounds read of x when n exceeds the readable x buffer
findings.severity: high if real: read past a borrowed caller buffer
findings.rationale: Illustrative fixture entry, not a record of a real external review. A caller can pass n larger than the readable values of x; the sum loop would then read past the buffer. source_identity is the sha256 of json.dumps({path: sha256}, sort_keys=True) over the fixture files under src/, include/, tests/project/, fuzz/project/, specs/project/ and review/ (paths relative to tests/fixtures/project-library, review/ledger.json excluded).
findings.reproducer: tests/project/test_entry.c test_entry: fixture_entry(x, FIXTURE_ENTRY_MAX + 1, &out) and fixture_entry(x, SIZE_MAX, &out) return 1 and leave out unchanged; fuzz target entry passes every input length with a 64-value buffer

history.reason: Not a defect: fixture_entry refuses n > FIXTURE_ENTRY_MAX at src/entry.c:6 before the loop reads any element; the n = 65 and SIZE_MAX tests and the fuzz target cover it. The contract (specs/project/entry.md) requires at least n readable values only for n in [1, 64].
